prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design an exceptionally beautiful, memorable macOS app icon for Mixless, a premium DJ and automatic music mixing app. Art direction: a jewel-like miniature dual-deck DJ console, with the taste and restraint of the finest independent Mac apps. A sculptural dark graphite controller seen from a carefully composed elevated three-quarter view, rotated diagonally a little to fill the square gracefully. Two large vinyl-like jog wheels are the heroes: concentric satin titanium grooves, obsidian centers, fine luminous warm amber and vermilion rims. A tiny clean central mixing strip with two silver fader caps connects the decks. A few intentional warm-lit controls only. The hardware silhouette is generously rounded, beautifully proportioned, bold and immediately recognizable at small size. Exquisite machined-metal edges, soft studio highlights, controlled warm reflected light, believable depth, rich contrast. Place it centrally on an edge-to-edge deep midnight graphite backdrop with a very subtle ember glow behind the object. The object occupies most of the canvas with comfortable breathing room. Make the result emotionally desirable, elegant, musical and professional, with one unmistakable focal subject. Simplify details like a crafted app icon, not a photograph of complicated equipment. Full square 1024 image, background reaches the corners; do not draw a separate outer app tile or border. No text, letters, numbers, labels, brands, watermark, screen mockup, multiple variants, oversized glow, rainbow neon, or plastic toy look.
